image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Nile crocodile resting on a light-colored stone or concrete ledge. The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper torso, showing detailed skin texture, closed eyes, and visible teeth along the jawline. One forelimb is tucked against the body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nostrils, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple sharp, conical teeth are clearly visible protruding from the lower jaw even though the mouth is closed, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye appears closed or heavily squinted in this lighting/pose; vertical slit pupils and the nictitating membrane are not visually resolvable.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostril openings are clearly visible at the very end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows heavy, rigid-looking armor plating.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony scutes are visible running down the back and neck.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is greyish-brown and the texture is visibly rough and pebbled.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The belly/ventral side is obscured by the angle of the photo and the ledge the crocodile is resting on.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only one forelimb is partially visible and tucked in; digit count and webbing details are not clear enough to verify strictly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely outside the frame of the image.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification based on snout shape and scale pattern.
To analyze the high-frequency details of the scales for any AI-generated smearing or repetition artifacts.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness between subject and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the scales. AI often generates 'muddy' or overly repetitive patterns in reptile skin. Verify if the scute rows maintain logical continuity as they curve around the neck. Check the teeth for any signs of melting into the gum line.

metadata.class_label: African crocodile, Nile crocodile, Crocodylus niloticus
